_comment: Copy to config.json on the rig (or point CLIPPER_CONFIG at it). This file holds NO secrets — a route names a credsEnv and the tokens are read from the service environment as <credsEnv>_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET/_REFRESH_TOKEN (YouTube) or <credsEnv>_CLIENT_KEY/_SECRET/_REFRESH_TOKEN (TikTok). Find a game's gameId by running: node server/clipper/run.js --dry-run  (it logs each clip's game id and name). One account = one route that lists all of its gameIds, so 'perAccount' caps that whole account. 'exclude' lists categories that must never be posted anywhere (IRL / Just Chatting / Music are the usual ones) - it is checked before the routes AND before the fallback. 'schedule' sets how far ahead YouTube publishes and at what local times (TikTok has no scheduling API and posts same-day). 'trending' promotes recent clips that are already performing ahead of the backlog. 'render.zoom' crops the source sides before scaling so gameplay fills more of the 9:16 frame and stays sharper: 1.0 = full width (smallest/softest), 1.33 = default, 1.78 = crop to square (sharpest, but loses the outer 44% - too much for a shooter's HUD). A route may override it with its own 'zoom'.
